_readme: Radio Irad programme data, in the same format as schedule.json (see newsroom/README.md, TV schedule). Times are Irad Time; the radio day runs 05:00 to 05:00.

signon.title: Sign On
signon.desc: Radio Irad opens with The Spirit of Irad.

signoff.title: Close Down
signoff.desc: Radio Irad closes for the night with The Spirit of Irad.

farm_weather.title: Farm and Weather
farm_weather.desc: Weather for the valleys and the passes, water releases on the Chu and the Naryn, and the morning's feed and livestock prices.

talas_morning.title: Talas Morning
talas_morning.desc: The breakfast show: music, roads, guests and OneNews on the hour.

iradi_lessons.title: Tilge Kaytuu
iradi_lessons.subtitle: Back to the Language
iradi_lessons.desc: Fifteen minutes of everyday Iradi for learners, part of the language revival.

bazaar_hour.title: The Bazaar Hour
bazaar_hour.desc: Prices, shopping and household money, with reporters at the Bazar-i Kalan.

country_road.title: Country Road
country_road.desc: Iradi country-folk, from the Swift Hooves records to today's pickers.

news_noon.title: OneNews at Noon
news_noon.desc: The midday news from IradOne's newsroom in Talas.

agri_bulletin.title: Agricultural Bulletin
agri_bulletin.desc: Grain, cotton and feedlot prices, pasture and water reports, and veterinary notices.

requests.title: Afternoon Requests
requests.desc: Listeners' songs and dedications, by phone and SMS.

book_at_three.title: Book at Three
book_at_three.desc: A serial reading from Iradi literature.

mor_pop_hour.title: Mor-Pop Hour
mor_pop_hour.desc: The newest Mor-Pop and Iradi pop.

talas_drive.title: Talas Drive
talas_drive.desc: The drive-time show: roads and passes, the day's news and music for the commute.

news_evening.title: OneNews Evening
news_evening.desc: The evening news and the next day's weather.

herders_hour.title: Malchylar Saaty
herders_hour.subtitle: The Herders' Hour
herders_hour.desc: Messages, family news and market prices for herding families on the summer and winter pastures, in Iradi.

sports_desk.title: Sports Desk
sports_desk.desc: Hippodrome results, the ulak tartysh league and the day's football.

news_eight_sim.title: OneNews at Eight
news_eight_sim.desc: The main evening bulletin, shared with IradOne television.

kechki_jomok.title: Kechki Jomok
kechki_jomok.subtitle: Evening Tales
kechki_jomok.desc: Bards, küü for the komuz and listeners' genealogies, on Radio Irad since 1994.

saturday_market.title: Saturday Market
saturday_market.desc: A morning at the bazaar: produce, prices and the people who sell them.

farm_week.title: The Farming Week
farm_week.desc: The week in agriculture, with the Talas valley feedlots and the Chu basin growers.

ulak_radio.title: Ulak Tartysh Live
ulak_radio.desc: Full commentary from tonight's league match.

sunday_qurbana.title: Sunday Qurbana
sunday_qurbana.desc: The Divine Liturgy of the Syro-Iradi Catholic Church, on radio.

week_in_review.title: The Week in Irad
week_in_review.desc: The week's news, with the IradOne correspondents.

irad_day_radio.title: Irad Day Live
irad_day_radio.desc: Commentary from the flag ceremony and parade in Talas.

easter_radio.title: Kyamta: The Resurrection
easter_radio.desc: The Easter Divine Liturgy from Iyık Janyl.

janyl_radio.title: Feast of St. Janyl
janyl_radio.desc: The feast-day liturgy from Iyık Janyl.

new_year_radio.title: New Year's Eve
new_year_radio.desc: Music to midnight and the Governor's New Year message.

election_radio.title: Election Night 2027
election_radio.desc: Results as they come in from the Territorial Election Commission.
